title: Wasmtime 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contains a leftover assertion in component::Func::call that…
description: Wasmtime versions 46.0.0 before 48.0.6 and 49.0.0 before 49.0.3 contain a leftover assertion in the component::Func::call function. This assertion rejects guest exports using the async ABI option. An attacker supplying a component with an async-lifted export can cause the host process to crash when the embedder invokes that export via Func::call.
